# My Agent

Meet Weekend Warrior, a GitHub agent designed to maximize your productivity during Saturday and Sunday. It automatically triages non-critical issues and prepares a "Monday Morning" briefing so you can focus on deep work without getting bogged down in administrative tasks. The agent optimizes your CI/CD pipelines for off-peak hours, ensuring your weekend projects deploy smoothly and efficiently. It even handles basic dependency updates and security patches, keeping your repositories healthy while you enjoy your time off. By managing the noise of active development, Weekend Warrior helps you maintain a perfect balance between personal coding and professional rest.
